@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#1A120B;--card:#2A1D12;--tx:#FFF3D0;--mut:#D9C79E;--ln:#44301D;--bl:#5DB4EE}}

html,body{height:100%}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--tx);font:15px/1.5 'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif}
body.lock{overflow:hidden}
#site{transition:opacity .9s ease .2s,transform .9s ease .2s}
body.lock #site{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
h1,h2,p{margin:0}
#intro{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10;background:#000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;transition:opacity .7s ease,visibility .7s}
#intro.done{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}
#intro::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#F5E43D,#F6E8B2);opacity:0;transition:opacity 1s}
#intro.lit::before{opacity:1}
#stage{position:relative;width:min(100%,calc(100dvh*16/9),1280px);aspect-ratio:16/9}
#v{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
#ball{position:absolute;left:49.2%;top:51%;width:88px;height:88px;margin:-44px 0 0 -44px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.35) 0 28%,transparent 62%);cursor:grab;touch-action:none;padding:0}
#ball:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #FFFFFF;outline-offset:2px}
#ball.go{opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .3s}
#ball::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:6px;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);border-radius:50%;animation:pl 1.6s ease-out infinite}
#ball.drag::after{animation:none;opacity:0}
@keyframes pl{from{transform:scale(.6);opacity:1}to{transform:scale(1.3);opacity:0}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#ball::after{animation:none}}
#hint{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:min(calc(50% + min(100vw,calc(100dvh*16/9),1280px)*9/32 + 120px),calc(100% - 90px));display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;text-align:center;color:#FFFFFF;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.02em;transition:opacity .3s;pointer-events:none}
#hint svg{animation:bn 1.4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes bn{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:.6}50%{transform:translateY(6px);opacity:1}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#hint svg{animation:none}}
#track{position:absolute;left:49.2%;top:51%;width:2px;height:150px;margin-left:-1px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.7),rgba(255,255,255,0));pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .4s}
#goal{position:absolute;left:49.2%;top:calc(51% + 150px);width:60px;height:60px;margin:-30px 0 0 -30px;border:2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.6);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;transition:all .3s}
#goal.on{border-style:solid;border-color:#F6B81C;box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(246,184,28,.8)}
#intro.playing #track,#intro.playing #goal{opacity:0}
#skip{position:absolute;top:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));right:16px;min-height:44px;padding:0 16px;border:0;border-radius:22px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.65);color:#FFFFFF;font:600 13px 'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;z-index:2}

.prod{overflow:hidden}

.pp{height:268px;width:auto;margin-bottom:8px;filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 12px rgba(42,27,16,.3))}
.pl{position:absolute;right:6%;bottom:10px;width:46%;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 8px rgba(42,27,16,.35))}

.step button{width:44px;height:44px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--tx);color:var(--bg);font-size:22px;font-weight:600;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;padding:0}
.step output{min-width:28px;text-align:center;font-weight:800;font-size:16px}
.stp{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center}
.stp i{width:36px;height:36px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ac);color:#2A1B10;font-style:normal;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.ft{padding:24px 20px 110px;border-top:1px solid var(--ln);font-size:14px;color:var(--mut);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
#bar{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:0;transform:translateX(-50%);width:100%;max-width:480px;z-index:5;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:12px 20px calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));background:var(--card);color:var(--tx);border-top:1px solid var(--ln);box-shadow:0 -6px 18px rgba(42,27,16,.15)}
#bar[hidden]{display:none}
</style>

<script>
(function(){
var intro=document.getElementById('intro'),v=document.getElementById('v'),ball=document.getElementById('ball'),hint=document.getElementById('hint'),skip=document.getElementById('skip'),site=document.getElementById('site');
var goal=document.getElementById('goal'),MAXD=150,SCRUB=1.5,prog=0,drag=false,startY=0,played=false,opened=false;
function setProg(p){prog=p;try{v.currentTime=p*SCRUB}catch(e){}ball.style.transform='translateY('+(p*MAXD)+'px)';goal.classList.toggle('on',p>0.5)}
function openSite(){if(opened)return;opened=true;intro.classList.add('done');document.body.classList.remove('lock');site.removeAttribute('inert');v.pause();setTimeout(function(){intro.style.display='none'},800)}
function play(){if(played)return;played=true;intro.classList.add('playing');goal.classList.remove('on');ball.classList.add('go');hint.style.opacity=0;var p=v.play();if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(openSite)}
v.addEventListener('loadedmetadata',function(){try{v.currentTime=0.01}catch(e){}});
v.addEventListener('timeupdate',function(){if(v.currentTime>2.8)intro.classList.add('lit');if(v.currentTime>=6.2)openSite()});
v.addEventListener('ended',openSite);
ball.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){if(played)return;drag=true;startY=e.clientY-prog*MAXD;ball.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);ball.classList.add('drag');ball.style.cursor='grabbing';hint.style.opacity=0});
ball.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){if(!drag)return;setProg(Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(e.clientY-startY)/MAXD)))});
function end(){if(!drag)return;drag=false;ball.classList.remove('drag');ball.style.cursor='grab';if(prog>0.5){play()}else{back()}}
function back(){if(prog<=0.01){setProg(0);hint.style.opacity=1;return}setProg(prog*0.86);requestAnimationFrame(back)}
ball.addEventListener('pointerup',end);ball.addEventListener('pointercancel',end);
ball.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '||e.key==='ArrowDown'){e.preventDefault();play()}});
skip.addEventListener('click',openSite);
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
var IMG={"mp": "data:image/webp;base64,", "cp": "data:image/webp;base64,", "mpl": "data:image/webp;base64,", "cpl": "data:image/webp;base64,", "logo": "data:image/webp;base64,"};
document.querySelectorAll('img[data-i]').forEach(function(el){el.src=IMG[el.getAttribute('data-i')]});
var P={manis:{n:'Kripik Pisang Manis',p:12000,q:0},coklat:{n:'Kripik Pisang Coklat',p:12000,q:0}};
var NO='6282338651005';
function rp(n){return 'Rp '+n.toLocaleString('id-ID')}
function upd(){var t=0,c=0,l=[];for(var k in P){var x=P[k];document.getElementById('q-'+k).textContent=x.q;if(x.q){t+=x.q*x.p;c+=x.q;l.push('- '+x.q+'x '+x.n)}}
var bar=document.getElementById('bar');bar.hidden=c===0;
document.getElementById('barN').textContent=c+' kemasan';document.getElementById('barT').textContent=rp(t);
var m='Halo Gedhang, saya mau pesan:\n'+l.join('\n')+'\nTotal: '+rp(t);
document.getElementById('barA').href='https://wa.me/'+NO+'?text='+encodeURIComponent(m)}
document.querySelectorAll('.step button').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){var x=P[b.dataset.k];x.q=Math.max(0,Math.min(20,x.q+Number(b.dataset.d)));upd()})});
})();
</script>
